questions.text: Explain the composition of a Gram Panchayat.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the composition of a Gram Panchayat. (A)

answer.value: The Gram Panchayat is the institution that exists at the lowest level as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj system. Gram Panchayats are formed based on population. A Gram Panchayat is formed for a village or a group of two or three villages having a population of about 5,000 to 7,000.
